evidence.title: How to Design Landing Pages That Capture Attention and Earn Trust

name: How to Design Landing Pages That Capture Attention and Earn Trust
summary: Article and infographic on the landing page elements that capture attention and build trust.
description: A blog post by Mark Ford, published 21 November 2025, walking through the core principles of landing page design: above-the-fold elements, calls to action, benefit features, social proof and the closing argument, with a summary infographic. Part of a web design agency's blog.
